predictions: Ok, that's a little more like it (although still not earth-shaking), as I put up a 16-7 record last week (which is, sadly, only my 4th week with 7 or fewer wrong picks this season). I did make up for any success by making sure I was wrong with both Matt's Tab and Uber Out, as per usual. I now sit at 162-90 (64.3% correct pick rate) for the season. While I've rebounded in C division a bit, I still really need to learn a ton about B and D divisions. Kinda running out of time, it appears…

Match of the week: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Off Constantly- Reboot. With the Bandits only posting a 0.500 record in their last four matches, whichever team wins this pairing of teams only one match off the lead (and in a near-dead heat in points), has to feel decent about its title chances. That's especially true for Constantly, who still gets to play the Bandits. Menace won this last time, but I'm taking OC, 13-11.

Match #2: (A Div.) Liver Alliance @ The Bullies. Liver might be a bit too far behind on points to take the A crown, but if they can win out, then… maybe? In any case, this is The Bullies' biggest hurdle on the way to a potential week 14 automatic tiebreaker, uh, I mean, show- down. Liver is really strong, but The Bullies are just a beast. 16-8.

Match #3: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ Darty Sanchez. Show Me is the only C team with fewer than 4 losses, and this pairing might well decide who is the favorite in the race for the #2 slot (and the likely climb to B in the fall). The Niners took this one seven weeks ago, but there's something about Sanchez (who has scored 11+ in all but one match). Sanchez, 13-11.

Matches #4 & #5: (F Div.) Bangin The Wire @ Village Idiots; Dart Side of the Moon @ Sofa Kings. The Idiots and Sofa each sit one match behind Ton 80 (although Sofa has a serious point deficit problem). So these matchups against the 4th/5th place teams are important in a you- better-not-lose-focus-and-drop-an-unexpected-one kind of way. To punctuate that point, seven weeks ago, Sofa did just that in a loss to Dart Side. I think the Idiots are in a decent spot still, and they handle their business, 14-10. And while I would love to go with Dart Side again in this matchup, Sofa just has a lot to play for and comes through, 13-11.

Match #6: (A Div.) Lunatic Fringe @ The Global Element. Much like match #2, this one has an A title contender hoping to avoid a trap week on the way to what could be another week 14 classic. Element hasn't been flashy, but has been deep and solid, and takes this, 16-8.

Match #7: (H Div.) Nein Mark @ Ones Are Closed. With the Corks having to face Rippin tonight, the door could be open for Nein to make a move on 2nd place here. Of course, Nein has to face Rippin next week, soooo… But before all that, Nein Mark gets this, 14-10.

Matches #8 & #9: (B Div.) Put It on Matt's Tab @ Iceman's Ear Defenders; Dart Attack @ Blindsided. It seems like every time Serious stumbles, all the teams behind them left them off the hook. Well, Matt's Tab and Blindsided are still just one match (and some points) out of first, so drama is still high for them. They better not take a nap with these two near-contenders facing up on them. I'm guessing they both win here, but both just barely, 13-11 for each.

Match #10: (A Div.) Armed & Hammered @ Consistently Inconsis. Depending on how many teams sign up next season, either 5 or 6 of the 7 current A teams get to stay there next season. And this match could go a ways toward deciding who is/isn't in. Inconsistent, 15-9.

Match #11: (D Div.) Cheap Shots @ BullsHit. Only one match and a handful of points separates the bottom four in D, and up to two of those could be relegated to E in the fall. Matches within that group are now pretty significant. I'm going with BullsHit in a 1001 payback.

Match #12: (H Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ The Rock Bottoms. These two teams could be playing for… well… we know what they could be playing for. But this specific race has a lot more contenders than usual this season. We Throw It ekes it out, 13-11.
